storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for SpankBang makes it easy to save videos from SpankBang.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any video page on SpankBang, press play, and either click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the video stream from multiple sources, shows available quality options, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming, stream_url variable extraction, and SpankBang API detection automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder.

Key features:
- Automatic video detection from multiple sources (stream variables, SpankBang API, page scripts)
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Desktop notifications when downloads complete
- Dark-themed UI with red accents matching SpankBang branding
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to SpankBang.com and play a video
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any video page on SpankBang.com and press play. Then click the download button on the player, click the extension icon, or right-click and select "Download SpankBang Video."

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the source — typically multiple resolutions (240p through 1080p or higher). Formats are sorted by quality (highest first), with both MP4 and HLS options displayed.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. HLS streams are automatically converted to MP4 during download.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos save to your browser's default Downloads directory as MP4 files.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Does this work on mobile SpankBang?
faq.answer: The extension supports m.spankbang.com (mobile subdomain) when accessed from a desktop browser with extension support.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Press play on the video first. The extension needs the stream to start before detection works. If issues persist, refresh the page.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
